sections.section_title: The Vineyard Laborers and the Landowner's Generosity
sections.summary: The neutral reading presents a parable illustrating God's sovereign generosity in kingdom rewards, where the landowner pays all workers the same denarius regardless of hours worked, dismantling proportional merit-based expectations and completing the inclusio with 19:30.

The neutral reading presents the most detailed passion prediction, specifying delivery to chief priests and scribes, condemnation, delivery to Gentiles for mocking, flogging, and crucifixion, followed by resurrection on the third day.

sections.section_title: The Request of the Mother of Zebedee's Sons
sections.summary: The neutral reading presents a request for positions of honor that exposes the disciples' persistent misunderstanding of kingdom authority, with Jesus explaining that the cup he drinks is suffering and that positions at his right and left are prepared by the Father alone.

sections.section_title: The Indignation of the Ten and the Teaching on Servant-Leadership
sections.summary: The neutral reading presents Jesus defining greatness as service and the Son of Man's mission as giving his life as a ransom (lytron) for many (anti pollon), grounding the community's ethic in Jesus's own substitutionary act rather than in the Gentile model of domination.

sections.section_title: Two Blind Men Receive Mercy Outside Jericho
sections.summary: The neutral reading presents two blind men who correctly identify Jesus as Son of David, persist through the crowd's rebuke, receive healing through Jesus's compassion (splagchnizomai), and follow him toward Jerusalem in an act of discipleship.
